facts.fact: Paradigm Initiative, reported by The Point, says Parliament has passed the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Bill (the Data Protection Act) and that it awaits presidential assent, the final step before becoming law; the date is the article's published date, 2025-10-06.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Bill (Data Protection Act)

note: Only standing is stated; the article names no authority, regulations or application under the law.
